crew.overview: In this classic story of love and devotion set against the backdrop of the American Civil War, a wounded Confederate soldier named W.P. Inman deserts his unit and travels across the South, aiming to return to his young wife, Ada, who he left behind to tend their farm. As Inman makes his perilous journey home, Ada struggles to keep their home intact with the assistance of Ruby, a mysterious drifter sent to help her by a kindly neighbor.
crew.title: Cold Mountain

crew.overview: When a powerful satellite system falls into the hands of Alec Trevelyan, AKA Agent 006, a former ally-turned-enemy, only James Bond can save the world from a dangerous space weapon that -- in one short pulse -- could destroy the earth! As Bond squares off against his former compatriot, he also battles Xenia Onatopp, an assassin who uses pleasure as her ultimate weapon.
crew.title: GoldenEye

crew.overview: When an attack on the Kingsman headquarters takes place and a new villain rises, Eggsy and Merlin are forced to work together with the American agency known as the Statesman to save the world.
crew.title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle

crew.overview: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.
crew.title: Deadpool & Wolverine

crew.overview: A bank teller discovers he is actually a background player in an open-world video game, and decides to become the hero of his own story. Now, in a world where there are no limits, he is determined to be the guy who saves his world his way before it's too late.
crew.title: Free Guy

crew.overview: In a world where people collect pocket-size monsters (Pokémon) to do battle, a boy comes across an intelligent monster who seeks to be a detective.
crew.title: Pokémon Detective Pikachu

crew.overview: An Amazon princess comes to the world of Man in the grips of the First World War to confront the forces of evil and bring an end to human conflict.
crew.title: Wonder Woman

crew.overview: In Los Angeles, a gang of bank robbers who call themselves The Ex-Presidents commit their crimes while wearing masks of Reagan, Carter, Nixon and Johnson. Believing that the members of the gang could be surfers, the F.B.I. sends young agent Johnny Utah to the beach undercover to mix with the surfers and gather information.
crew.title: Point Break

crew.overview: Major Bill Cage is an officer who has never seen a day of combat when he is unceremoniously demoted and dropped into combat. Cage is killed within minutes, managing to take an alpha alien down with him. He awakens back at the beginning of the same day and is forced to fight and die again... and again - as physical contact with the alien has thrown him into a time loop.
crew.title: Edge of Tomorrow

crew.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
crew.overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione walk away from their last year at Hogwarts to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes, putting an end to Voldemort's bid for immortality. But with Harry's beloved Dumbledore dead and Voldemort's unscrupulous Death Eaters on the loose, the world is more dangerous than ever.
crew.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1

crew.original_title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
crew.overview: When Harry Potter's name emerges from the Goblet of Fire, he becomes a competitor in a grueling battle for glory among three wizarding schools—the Triwizard Tournament. But since Harry never submitted his name for the Tournament, who did? Now Harry must confront a deadly dragon, fierce water demons and an enchanted maze only to find himself in the cruel grasp of He Who Must Not Be Named.
crew.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

crew.overview: A young boy wins a tour through the most magnificent chocolate factory in the world, led by the world's most unusual candy maker.
crew.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory

crew.overview: Edmond Dantés's life and plans to marry the beautiful Mercedes are shattered when his best friend, Fernand, deceives him. After spending 13 miserable years in prison, Dantés escapes with the help of a fellow inmate and plots his revenge, cleverly insinuating himself into the French nobility.
crew.title: The Count of Monte Cristo

crew.overview: In 19th century France, Jean Valjean, a man imprisoned for stealing bread, must flee a relentless policeman named Javert. The pursuit consumes both men's lives, and soon Valjean finds himself in the midst of the student revolutions in France.
crew.title: Les Misérables

crew.overview: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.
crew.title: The Fantastic 4: First Steps

details.biography:
Timothy Nicholas Wooster (born January 26, 1967) is a cinematographer and camera specialist. Born in Westminster, London, England, he built his career working on both major studio productions and innovative visual projects. A member of the Guild of British Camera Technicians (GBCT), Wooster has contributed his camera expertise to a wide range of films since the mid-1980s.

Wooster’s early work includes involvement in the cult sci-fi film Lifeforce (1985). He subsequently worked in underwater and second-unit cinematography on high-profile blockbusters, including The World Is Not Enough (1999), Cold Mountain (2003), and Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005).

In 2004, Wooster served as second unit camera operator on the visually ambitious Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow, and later took on similar roles in Wanted (2008) and 1408 (2007). He expanded his portfolio by shooting principal cinematography on the indie thriller U Want Me 2 Kill Him? (2013) and other independent features.

Wooster has also worked as director of photography on second units for several major studio films, including Free Guy (2021), the underwater sequences of A Quiet Place: Day One (2024), Deadpool & Wolverine (2024), and The Fantastic Four: First Steps (2025).
details.name: Tim Wooster
